name: Jesse Owens Park
summary: A run recorded with a Garmin watch on October 4, 2025.
notes: This is one recorded run (Garmin activity "Lawrence County Running"), not a measured or official race course. The route was not checked against a published course map.

elevation.method: Smoothed with a 5-point moving average, then every rise and fall added up. An estimate from a watch's elevation sensor.
